title: A3A marked event-kernel control audit

claims.statement: Therapy-induced A3A is reported to promote DSBs and genomic instability in DTPs; A3A loss lowers APOBEC mutations, clusters/SVs, and resistant outgrowth in the cited models.
claims.limitations: Does not establish a specific cluster/SV-to-established-resistance lineage link; models do not provide the complete marked offspring kernel.

claims.statement: A3A manipulation changes DTP colony formation/survival as well as mutation/SV burden and resistant outgrowth, so total resistance differences cannot be attributed to a per-division mutagenesis change without measuring the joint state/offspring process.
claims.limitations: The inference does not identify the direction or size of any direct mutation-specific effect. A3A3B, DNA damage, survival, division, and state changes need separate measurement.

claims.statement: Per-site APOBEC mutation-rate and first-hit delay projections for NSCLC resistance are prior art; the 2025 projection study covers 21 patients and 42 variants and explicitly recognizes a possible indirect persister-reservoir path to APOBEC-independent resistance.
claims.limitations: That paper does not model joint cluster/SV event marks, multitype persister branching, or measured clone-specific establishment.

claims.statement: If complete marked no-escape offspring PGFs are ordered pointwise for every state, then the greater PGF policy has weakly lower eventual escape probability for every initial persister composition under independent branching.
claims.limitations: Sufficient but not necessary; relies on complete kernels, independent lineages, stationary policy and measured event-specific no-establishment weights. The mathematical comparison is standard in spirit; no novelty claim.

claims.statement: In a hypothetical one-event compound resistance model, two event laws with identical 1% per-locus marginals and identical expected total mutations per burst produce 0.796687 versus 0.015872 escape risk from 1000 persister founders under the stated branching parameters, a 50.19-fold difference.
claims.limitations: All event probabilities and establishment probabilities are illustrative assumptions, not cancer measurements. The paired-event route is hypothetical; no clinical inference follows.

claims.statement: The 2023/2025 source findings do not show that A3A-linked joint clusters or structural variants generate an established resistant lineage in the same persister lineage, and do not identify a robust beneficial A3A policy after accounting for divisions, death, damage, A3B, and APOBEC-independent routes.
claims.limitations: This is a scoped literature statement, not proof of global novelty; further primary-art checking is required before any priority claim.

claims.statement: A lineage-resolved assay can discriminate a direct A3A event-kernel change from a mere change in persister reservoir only if it jointly measures state/offspring, divisions/deaths, DNA damage, linked mutation/SV bundles, and genotype-specific rechallenge establishment.
claims.limitations: Experiment unperformed; costs and rare-event power are not yet priced; a failed identifiability or throughput gate yields UNKNOWN.

rejected_routes.route: APOBEC first-hit or per-site rate projection under complete suppression
